shortDescription: USB 3.0 to SATA 2.5 Inch Hard Drive Converter Cable (High-Speed USB 3.0 Interface / Supports 2.5 Inch SATA I II III HDDs & SSDs / Up to 5Gbps Data Transmission / Plug & Play Installation / Hot-Swappable Design)Ea
descriptionHtml:
USB 3.0 to SATA 2.5 Inch Hard Drive Converter Cable (High-Speed USB 3.0 Interface / Supports 2.5 Inch SATA I II III HDDs & SSDs / Up to 5Gbps Data Transmission / Plug & Play Installation / Hot-Swappable Design)

Easily connect any internal 2.5-inch SATA hard drive or solid-state drive to your computer using the USB 3.0 to SATA 2.5 Inch Hard Drive Converter Cable, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Perfect for fast drive cloning, data recovery, and external storage expansion, this compact adapter cable delivers ultra-fast transfer speeds up to 5Gbps without requiring additional power adapters or external drivers.
